methodology.javaSymbols: Fresh independent javac --release 8 source attribution; compare every explicitly declared type/method/field, inheritance, method/explicit-constructor call target, new expression, import and type use. Add expression-level return-type attribution, which previous signature-only checks did not cover.
methodology.javaExecution: Independent JDK compiler API parse + --release 8 attribution; each explicit source callable and operation compared by full source range against persisted method summary. No analyzer extraction code reused.
methodology.jsp: Original character scanner -> raw and semantic AST exact content/ranges/parent ownership; independent Tomcat ELParser AST shape/precedence for every EL; source TLD regex schemas, recursive static taglib bindings, include/param mapping, classpath javap signatures. No EL function or tag execution.
methodology.graphReport: Source hashes/TASK and web.xml independently scanned; cross-layer multiset and inverse-index checks; all report/usage/detail APIs queried read-only. Java/JSP parser source accuracy is separately audited by independent compiler/parser tools.

graphChecks.name: All 84 original inputs still match analyzed content
All raw graph records survive file graph conversion without extras
Every one of 646 indexed Java call sites has exactly one graph edge
All 69 file records retain exact outgoing/incoming symbol and edge-type sets
All six reverse indexes match their raw provenance
All literal TASK codes match source location, raw text and counts
Both HTTP mappings and actual handler identities match web.xml and source index
All 27 JSP report/API projections preserve source-backed graph relationship sets
All project/external usage queries match raw call/handler provenance
69 detail API source previews are complete and equal original source

exclusions: Non-Java/JSP scanner inputs are hash-checked; SQL/database, CSS and runtime behavior are not semantic audit targets.
Compiler-generated implicit constructors/resource closes, documented annotation dependencies and complete runtime CFG are outside this audit contract.
